description.value: Gold River Liquor Express is a local liquor retail outlet serving the small, remote community of Gold River on Vancouver Island. For touring cyclists making the long run up or down the Tahsis/Gold River corridor, it offers a potential resupply point for beverages. Gold River is one of the few service stops in this otherwise very isolated stretch of the island.
